title: Y2K Disney
intro: [excited] The computers survived Y2K, and so did we! Today's board is all about Disney in the two-thousands: new animated films, Disney Channel hits, Pixar, pirates and brand new parks. [laughs] Flip phones up, everybody.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A glossy early-2000s scene: a translucent coloured desktop computer, a flip phone, a portable CD player with headphones, glitter gel pens and a sparkly pink-and-silver backdrop.

categories.title: Experimental Era
categories.intro: Our film category: Experimental Era, Walt Disney Animation's big, weird, wonderful two-thousands.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A blue alien experiment pod, a llama-shaped lever and a forest bear cave at sunset, playful science-lab lighting.

clues.clue: In Lilo & Stitch, Stitch's original name is Experiment this number.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 626! [laughs] Built to destroy, but really he just wanted an ohana.

clues.clue: In The Emperor's New Groove, Kuzco is turned into this animal.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a llama! [excited] Pull the lever, Kronk! Wrong lever!

clues.clue: In Brother Bear, Kenai becomes a bear and travels with this talkative young cub.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Koda! [chuckles] Kenai is the brother. Koda is the cub who won't stop talking.

clues.clue: In Bolt, the super dog teams up with this TV-loving hamster who rolls around in a plastic ball.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rhino! [laughs] Small hamster, enormous attitude.

clues.clue: Meet the Robinsons ends with this Walt Disney quote, which is also the family's motto.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Keep moving forward! [excited] Walt said it best. We keep opening new doors.

categories.title: Remote Control Classics
categories.intro: [excited] Grab the remote! This category is all about the Disney Channel shows we couldn't stop watching in the two-thousands.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A teen bedroom in the 2000s with a chunky silver TV, beaded curtain, inflatable chair, a microphone and a glittery wig on a stand.

clues.clue: Miley Stewart secretly lives a double life as this pop star.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hannah Montana! [laughs] A blonde wig, and nobody can tell. You get the best of both worlds.

clues.clue: Troy and Gabriella sing Start of Something New in this 2006 Disney Channel movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is High School Musical! [excited] Go Wildcats! We're all in this together.

clues.clue: Zack and Cody live in a fancy Boston hotel with this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Tipton! [laughs] Mr. Moseby would like you to stop running in the lobby.

clues.clue: Kim Possible's sidekick Ron Stoppable carries a naked mole rat named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rufus! [excited] So what's the sitch? Rufus is the real hero, and everybody knows it.

clues.clue: On Lizzie McGuire, her best friend Gordo's real first name is this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is David! [chuckles] David Gordon. Nobody called him that, ever.

categories.title: Pixar Prop Closet
categories.intro: Picture time! Each picture is full of clues from a two-thousands Pixar film. Name the movie.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A messy prop closet at an animation studio: a red super suit on a hanger, a chef hat, traffic cones, a potted seedling in a boot and a diving mask.

clues.clue: A clownfish in a sea anemone. Which 2000s Pixar movie is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Finding Nemo! [excited] Fish are friends, not food.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A small orange-and-white striped clownfish peeking out of a purple sea anemone on a bright coral reef, a diver's mask lying on the sand, a dentist office fish tank glimpsed in a bubble.

clues.clue: A super suit on a mannequin, and no capes allowed. Which 2000s Pixar movie is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Incredibles! [laughs] And remember, no capes!

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sleek futuristic fashion design studio with a red-and-black super suit on a mannequin, a cape crossed out on a sketch pad, rocket-shaped furniture.

clues.clue: A desert motel made of giant traffic cones. Which 2000s Pixar movie is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cars! [excited] Radiator Springs, where the motel rooms are giant traffic cones. Ka-chow!

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sleepy desert town on an old highway at dusk, a motel made of giant orange traffic cones, glowing neon signs without lettering, red rock buttes in the distance.

clues.clue: A chef's hat and a fancy Paris kitchen. Which 2000s Pixar movie is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ratatouille! [chuckles] A tall chef's hat, a fancy Paris kitchen and a dish named after a peasant stew.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A gleaming Paris restaurant kitchen at night, a tall white chef toque on the counter, a plate of thinly sliced layered vegetables in a spiral, copper pots and a view of the Eiffel Tower through the window.

clues.clue: A tiny seedling in a boot, surrounded by trash. Which 2000s Pixar movie is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is WALL-E! [whispers] A single green seedling in an old boot. That's how you save a planet.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A single green seedling growing inside an old worn boot, surrounded by towers of stacked compacted trash cubes under a dusty orange sky, a cockroach on a rusty lunchbox.

categories.title: Millennium Park Hopping
categories.intro: Time to park hop through the two-thousands, when Disney opened brand new parks and some very famous rides.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sweeping dawn panorama of a theme park with a snowy mountain coaster, a hang-glider soaring over golden hills and a lantern-lit harbour skyline.

clues.clue: Disney California Adventure opened next to Disneyland in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2001! [laughs] It opened in February and has been rebuilt quite a bit since.

clues.clue: This Disney park opened on Lantau Island in 2005.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hong Kong Disneyland! It opened in September 2005, making it Disney's second resort in Asia after Tokyo.

clues.clue: This 2006 Animal Kingdom coaster has a yeti waiting inside the mountain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Expedition Everest! [gasps] The train even goes backwards. Watch out for the yeti!

clues.clue: This 2001 hang-gliding ride debuted at Disney California Adventure, then came to EPCOT in 2005.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Soarin'! [laughs] Smell the orange groves, and try not to drop your shoes.

clues.clue: This EPCOT ride, a spinning centrifuge, opened in 2003 where Horizons used to stand.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mission: SPACE! [laughs] It was so intense they added a gentler version. Please take the motion sickness bags seriously.

categories.title: Savvy?
categories.intro: [laughs] Our wildcard is The Curse of the Black Pearl, the 2003 movie based on the ride. Savvy?

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A ghostly pirate ship with black sails under a full moon, a chest of Aztec gold coins on a beach, a skeleton hand reaching for a medallion.

clues.clue: Johnny Depp plays this pirate captain. Make sure you say Captain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Captain Jack Sparrow! [laughs] Why is the rum gone?

clues.clue: Barbossa's cursed crew sails this ship with black sails.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Black Pearl! It's the ship in the movie's title.

clues.clue: This actor plays the blacksmith Will Turner.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Orlando Bloom! [chuckles] Blacksmith by day, swordsman whenever he needs to save Elizabeth.

clues.clue: The curse on Barbossa's crew comes from this civilization's gold.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aztec! [whispers] Take one coin and you're cursed. In the moonlight, the crew are skeletons.

clues.clue: Barbossa's pet monkey has the same name as this person.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jack! [laughs] The monkey is named after Jack Sparrow, just to annoy him.
